title: Foundation of AI Agentic Engineering
description:
Learn to design, build, and deploy autonomous AI agents capable of reasoning, using tools, and orchestrating complex workflows.

Course Structure (5 Units, 12 Lessons):
• Unit 1: أساسيات الوكلاء الأذكياء (Fundamentals of AI Agents)
• Unit 2: الأدوات والمنصات (Tools and Platforms)
• Unit 3: تصميم أول وكيل ذكي لك (Designing Your First AI Agent)
• Unit 4: سير العمل والتعاون (Workflows and Collaboration)
• Unit 5: الاختبار والممارسات الفضلى (Testing and Best Practices)
